title: HIDE: Hierarchical Isolation via Documentation and Evidence for Rustc Bugs
abstract: arXiv:2610.37343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rustc bugs can prevent valid programs from compiling or cause incorrect compilation results, making the identification of responsible source files essential for repair. Using large language models (LLMs) for rustc bug isolation raises three challenges. First, distributed compiler functionality requires understanding both what individual files do and how they work together. Second, a large source file search space makes exhaustive analysis of all files costly. Third, including documentation and source code for many candidate files in LLM prompts leads to context overload, which can reduce bug isolation accuracy. We propose HIDE, a hierarchical LLM-based approach that combines compiler documentation with bug evidence to rank suspicious rustc source files. translated_title: HIDE：基于文档与证据的 Rustc 缺陷层次化隔离方法
translated_abstract: Rustc 缺陷可能导致合法程序无法编译或产生错误的编译结果，因此识别出导致问题的源文件对于修复工作至关重要。使用大语言模型（LLM）进行 rustc 缺陷隔离面临三个挑战。首先，编译器功能具有分布式特性，需要同时理解各个文件的功能以及它们之间的协作方式。其次，庞大的源文件搜索空间使得对所有文件进行穷举分析的成本高昂。第三，在 LLM 提示中包含大量候选文件的文档和源代码会导致上下文过载，从而降低缺陷隔离的准确性。我们提出了 HIDE，一种基于 LLM 的层次化方法，它将编译器文档与缺陷证据相结合，对可疑的 rustc 源文件进行排序。给定一个 rustc 版本和缺陷上下文，HIDE 由两个阶段组成，分别用于生成编译器文档和缩小搜索空间。为了理解分布式的编译器功能……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HIDE 是一种基于大语言模型的层次化方法，通过将编译器文档与缺陷证据相结合来对可疑的 rustc 源文件进行排序，从而有效缩小搜索空间并提升 rustc 缺陷隔离的准确性。
en_tdlr: HIDE is a hierarchical LLM-based approach that combines compiler documentation with bug evidence to rank suspicious rustc source files, effectively narrowing the search space and improving rustc bug isolation accuracy.
